title: Sharp regression discontinuity: local linear with robust bias-corrected inference
summary: The jump in the outcome at a treatment threshold on a score, from local linear fits with an MSE-optimal bandwidth and the Calonico-Cattaneo-Titiunik robust interval.

sizing._why: RD power depends on the density of patients near the cut-off and the bandwidth; the rdpower package does it, no catalog form does.

pinned_defaults: Both (rdrobust, same authors in both languages): p = 1, q = 2, triangular kernel, bwselect = 'mserd', vce = 'nn' with nnmatch = 3.
Report the conventional estimate with the ROBUST bias-corrected interval.
Python: rdrobust imports its plotting module on import, so plotnine and matplotlib are pinned too.
_local: The effect is the jump at the cut-off, for patients near it. A global straight line on each side gives 0.66 here against a true 1.5, because the outcome curves.
